C1.worst_defect: The hero has four CTAs at nearly equal weight ('Live demo' filled, then 'Quick start', 'Try with your store', 'GitHub' as identical outlined boxes). On a 390 px screen they wrap into a ragged 2+2 block: the second row ('Try with your store' + 'GitHub') is wider than the first, so the next step after the demo is not clear.
C1.where: home.desktop.01 hero button row; home.phone.01 button block

C2.worst_defect: The quick start's opening paragraph names a second host, 'https://vendurepos.vercel.app serves the same build', and step 5 has to explain keeping it in CORS. On a page whose job is the first install, that reads as leaked infrastructure, and code names like TallyPosPlugin and tally-pos are never reconciled with the VendurePOS brand.

C3.worst_defect: Step 7 'Prepare the channel and stock, then restart Vendure' is a solid nine-line paragraph about stockLocationStrategy, top-ups and PaymentSettled, with no list or callout. The one action a developer needs (assign products and stock locations to the channel, keep the manual fulfilment handler, restart) is buried in edge-case prose.

C4.worst_defect: 'At the till' explains a whole UI (Cash in the drawer to start, Parked (n), Pay cash / Pay by card / Split, Complete sale) in bold-label prose with no screenshot of the till. On Changelog, the subtitle 'Released versions of the @vendurepos/plugin package, newest first.' is repeated word for word as the first paragraph.

C5.worst_defect: In the home comparison table under 'Live demo or your own store', column widths ignore content: the 'Live demo' column gets about 430 px to hold mostly 'Yes', while the row-label column is squeezed so 'Sales reach Vendure, once each, even offline' wraps. The docs sidebar's grey panel also stops dead at y≈900 on every docs page, leaving a notch at bottom left (docs.desktop.01, limitations.desktop.01).

C6.worst_defect: Code blocks on the critical path are clipped at 390 px with only a faint edge shadow as a scroll hint. 'plugins: [/* your existing plugins, */ Tally' loses TallyPosPlugin, the CORS line cuts off at "'ht", and the taxOptions block cuts both strategy names. The home comparison table also squeezes three columns, so 'Open and / close a / register with a / Z report' stacks to four lines.
C6.where: quick-start.phone.02 (step 2 + step 3 code), quick-start.phone.04 (cors), quick-start.phone.05 (taxOptions); home.phone.03 table

C7.worst_defect: The share card looks like a stock template, not the site: a hollow pink circle as the 'logo', pink 'VendurePOS' wordmark, a dashed rule and a purple footer bar. That palette appears nowhere on the monochrome site. The body also repeats the title ('Point of sale for Vendure' / 'Open-source point of sale for Vendure...') and there is no product image, although the site has a good till screenshot.

overall_worst.defect: On a phone the quick-start code blocks are cut off at the right edge, exactly where the lines matter: the plugin line ends at 'Tally', the CORS origin line at "'ht", and the taxOptions lines in mid-class-name. The only scroll cue is a faint shadow, so a developer reading the install path on a 390 px screen sees broken config.
overall_worst.fix: Write the long snippets as one item per line (break the plugins array, the cors origin array and the taxOptions values onto separate lines), or turn on line wrapping for code blocks below 640 px so no line is wider than the 390 px viewport.
